appearance.subtle: There are pale scored lines along the sides of their neck.
appearance.obvious: Gill slits open and close along their throat and lower ribs, wet and red at the edges.
appearance.extreme: Rows of working gills run their neck and flank, fanning when they breathe. Out of water they sound like something drowning slowly.

description: Slits have opened along your throat and ribs. Water stopped being something you hold your breath through.

name: Gills
